People: Francis Leopold M'Clintock (author, Wikidata Q969207), died 1907; Roderick Impey Murchison (introduction, Wikidata Q361900), died 1871. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("M'Clintock, Francis Leopold, Sir, 1819-1907; Murchison, Roderick Impey, Sir, 1792-1871 [Author of introduction, etc.]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The voyage of the 'Fox' in the Arctic seas : a narrative of the discovery of the fate of Sir John Franklin and his companions, London : J. Murray, 1859, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/voyageoffoxinarc00mcli_1. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 86%, 78%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Roderick Impey Murchison, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
